content: For homelab GitOps, monorepo platform repo is the recommended starting point (single source of truth, atomic changes, simple). Typical layout separates infrastructure/platform resources from apps/. ArgoCD ApplicationSets with a git directory generator auto-discover app folders (scaffolding = commit a folder); app-of-apps is the older nesting pattern. Multi-repo splits config/service/platform repos but loses atomic commits. Sources: cloudogu gitops-patterns, octopus.com, oneuptime blog series.
